name: Ben Tre
provinceNote: Nghị quyết 202/2025/QH15, clause 20: Bến Tre, Trà Vinh, and Vĩnh Long become the new Vĩnh Long province, 6,296.20 km² and 4,257,581 people, beside Đồng Tháp, Cần Thơ, and the sea.
dotReason: Worth a night when the coconut bank of the Tiền is the trip
summary: Coconut palms on the south bank of the Tiền, with Cồn Phụng and the walk at Hồ Trúc Giang. Stay the night if that bank is the trip. Sleep in My Tho if you wanted the north-bank embankment. From Ho Chi Minh City the road is 86 km and 1.5 hours, about two hours, about 85 km and about 2 hours, or 85–90 km and 1.5–2 hours, so the boat has to be the morning.
getThere: 86 km and 1.5 hours, about two hours, about 85 km and about 2 hours, or 85–90 km and 1.5–2 hours from Ho Chi Minh City. No passenger train.
seoTitle: Ben Tre travel guide — the coconut bank of the Tien
seoDescription: Stay for the coconut palms, Cồn Phụng, and Hồ Trúc Giang. The road from Ho Chi Minh City is 86 km and 1.5 hours, about two hours, or 85–90 km and 1.5–2 hours.
intro: You are on the south bank of the Tiền, on cù lao Bảo, with coconut palms in front of the town and boats leaving the pier into nipa creeks. Bảo is one of three strips the national rural page names, with Minh and An Hóa, cut by the Tiền, Hàm Luông, Ba Lai, and Cổ Chiên. Stay the night if that coconut bank is the trip. Sleep in My Tho if you wanted the north-bank embankment. The boat has to be the morning on a same-day return. The investment sheet prints 86 km and 1.5 hours by car on the Ho Chi Minh City–Trung Lương expressway. Vietnam Tourism prints about two hours. A travel page prints about 85 km and about 2 hours. A car-hire page prints 85–90 km and 1.5–2 hours.

Cồn Phụng is the orchard gate on this bank, not cù lao Thới Sơn. The national rural page places it in xã Tân Thạch, huyện Châu Thành, 12 km by road and 25 km by river from the city center. The operator page prints about 10 km, and the address ấp 10 (Ấp Tân Vinh), xã Phú Túc, tỉnh Vĩnh Long. Clause 59 of Nghị quyết 1687/NQ-UBTVQH15 merges thị trấn Châu Thành and the communes Tân Thạch, Tường Đa, and Phú Túc into xã Phú Túc. Ask for either name. The clause does not say the islet moved. The four nicknames are Long, Lân, Quy, and Phụng. Vietnam Tourism places Cù lao Long on this side, by a short ferry past the Ben Tre Market and the Ben Tre River. Lân is not assigned a bank. Quy is a longan orchard, and no kilometer was printed for it. The rural page prints no tariff for Cồn Phụng, so the gate is check on arrival. The Friday town cart is not the way onto the islet.

The morning the provincial tourism portal describes starts on đường 30 Tháng 4, then walks to Bảo tàng Bến Tre at 146 Hùng Vương. The portal prints phường An Hội. A travel page prints Phường 3 for the same number. Phường 4 and Phường 5 merged into An Hội from 1 December 2024, and clause 116 of Nghị quyết 1687 forms a new phường An Hội without naming Hùng Vương, so the number stays 146 Hùng Vương. One travel page prints 07:00–17:00 every day. Another prints 07:30–11:00 and 13:30–17:00. No museum tariff was opened, so the fee is check on arrival. After dinner the portal walks Hồ Trúc Giang, công viên Bến Tre, công viên Trần Văn Ơn, and công viên Đồng Khởi, then chợ đêm Bến Tre and khu phố chợ Phú Khương. Feet minutes between them are check on arrival. Công viên Đồng Khởi in town is not the Đồng Khởi relic at Định Thủy.

The palms are the crop, and the area figures do not match. The national tourism extract prints 53,000 ha, about a quarter of the country’s coconut land, and about 500 million nuts a year. The rural page prints more than 60,000 ha and about 500 million nuts. Báo Đồng Khởi, writing in 2019 about the 2015 festival, says the area was above 62,000 ha. All three areas stand. Candy, milk, oil, and shell craft are the products. The rural page says more than 500 coconut-shell objects. Vietnam Tourism says more than 300 coconut-candy factories. That factory count is one page.
gettingAround: No airport was named in the Ben Tre wards. The road from Ho Chi Minh City is the approach, and Tân Sơn Nhất is the airport at that end. Minutes from the terminal are check on arrival. No passenger station was named, so do not plan a train. A rail duration is check on arrival. A scheduled public boat from Ho Chi Minh City was not named. Tourist boats start once you are already on the river. Fares for the coach, a taxi, a motorbike, and a boat are check on arrival.

Vietnam Tourism says local buses connect the delta provinces with Bến xe Miền Tây and names Thảo Châu as one company to Ben Tre. A 2026 timetable was not opened. A station name, a bay, and a street for the Ben Tre coach station were not named. Check on arrival. The investment sheet names Quốc lộ 60 and Quốc lộ 57 as the roads that continue toward the old Vĩnh Long and Trà Vinh. A minute from this town to Cần Thơ was not printed.

From My Tho, Quốc lộ 60 crosses the Tiền on Cầu Rạch Miễu and on Cầu Rạch Miễu 2. A minute from the My Tho pier was not printed. Check on arrival. The state inspection page says Cầu Rạch Miễu 2 was ready to open from 19 August 2025, after a check on 12 August: more than 17.6 km in all, main bridge more than 1,971 m, investment more than 6,810 billion VND, from ngã tư Đồng Tâm in Đồng Tháp to Quốc lộ 60 in Vĩnh Long. VOV prints the length as about 17.6 km, the end near Km16+660, about 0.71 km from the north abutment of Cầu Hàm Luông, old TP. Bến Tre, now phường Bến Tre, and the start now xã Hưng Long, Đồng Tháp. Tuổi Trẻ prints the opening at about 11:30 on 19 August 2025, and the older bridge about 4 km downstream, still open that day. The temporary ferry stopped on 20 August 2025. The two “about 10 km” lines describe that ferry, not the drive from My Tho.

In town the walk is Hồ Trúc Giang and the three parks, then the night market and khu phố chợ Phú Khương. The near-city orchard boats leave bến tàu du lịch thành phố Bến Tre. A pier number was not in that sentence. A fare is check on arrival. Cồn Phụng is a different landing: 12 km by road and 25 km by river, or about 10 km. On Fridays and Saturdays the tourism portal prints a free seven-seat cart, pickup at Sense City at 17:30 and 19:30 and at 708 Nguyễn Văn Tư at 19:00 and 21:00. One timetable. Vietnam Tourism says cycling is the way through the groves and that most hotels lend bicycles. It does not name a rental shop. A bicycle fee is check on arrival. Use a taxi meter, and bargain a xe ôm. No price was printed. The tourism office at 108/1 đường 30/4 is an office, not a station. Phường 4 on that line is a pre-December 2024 name.

The Đồng Khởi relic is a second morning, not the boat. The national extract sends you across Cầu Hàm Luông on Quốc lộ 57, more than 10 km to thị trấn Mỏ Cày Nam, then left about 4 km. A travel page prints about 15 km from the city. The route and the 15 km both stand. Do not add them into one distance. Minutes are check on arrival. Cầu Hàm Luông is the river south of town. It is not Cầu Rạch Miễu. No toll for Hàm Luông was printed. Check on arrival. A town-center kilometer to that bridge was not printed.

stayAreas.name: The town bank
stayAreas.summary: A river room on the town bank, so the evening is Hồ Trúc Giang, the parks, and the night market.

stayAreas.name: A garden on a near islet
stayAreas.summary: A garden homestay where the portal sends the town boats, under the old names Mỹ Thạnh An and Phú Nhuận, or a house on Cồn Phụng if the night is the orchard rather than the lake. No brand.

eat: Breakfast on đường 30 Tháng 4 is hủ tiếu with a pork-pâté slice the provincial portal calls local. Vietnam Tourism describes a dinner bowl of the same noodle with pork, shrimp, a quail egg, lime, and cilantro. Keep both plates. Do not fold the pâté into the quail-egg bowl. A stall price is check on arrival. The street is the area.

Lunch on the boat is the garden table. The national rural page lists đuông dừa fried in butter, cá tai tượng chiên xù, xôi chiên phồng, lẩu mắm, cơm trái dừa, and tép rang dừa. Vietnam Tourism names creamy coconut rice, coconut-braised shrimp, and a light salad of củ hủ dừa. A recipe was not printed for any of them. Kẹo dừa is coconut milk and sugar, warm at the kiln or wrapped to take home. Vietnam Tourism says more than 300 coconut-candy factories. That count is one page. Honey tea is the sit-down drink in a coconut-leaf house, and on the town boat the guest mixes trà mật ong phấn hoa. A young coconut is cut open on the boat. No stall price was printed.

Bánh tráng Mỹ Lồng is rice paper from sticky rice and coconut milk, with sugar, salt, sesame, and sometimes milk or egg. The portal gives two origins and does not choose: elders say about 100 years, and another story ties the dry rations to the Nguyễn–Trịnh years. Bánh phồng Sơn Đốc is glutinous rice pounded with coconut milk and sugar, then grilled so the cracker puffs to 3–4 times its size. The same page says the craft is more than 100 years old and began as a Tết offering, and quotes 51 households, about 25 million crackers a year, and a cooperative of 20 members. One page. Both were listed as national intangible heritage by Quyết định số 4069/QĐ-BVHTTDL on 30 October 2018. Grill the paper or the cracker, or carry them home. The yards run all year and longer near Tết. A price is check on arrival.
interestsBody: Give the morning to a boat on the Tiền. Cồn Phụng is the orchard gate. Cù lao Long is the short ferry past the market. Cồn Quy is longan. Lân has no bank named. The four nicknames are not one island, and Cồn Phụng is not cù lao Thới Sơn.
The palms are the crop: 53,000 ha, more than 60,000 ha, and above 62,000 ha, with about 500 million nuts a year on the two tourism pages. After dinner the walk is Hồ Trúc Giang and the market street.

Keep Đồng Khởi at Định Thủy, and the memorial of Nguyễn Đình Chiểu at Ba Tri, for another morning. The sea districts are a wild shore. Chợ Lách is fruit and ornamental gardens, and no single gate was named.

interestCards.title: The Tiền islets
interestCards.summary: A boat to Cồn Phụng, and a short ferry to Cù lao Long. The four nicknames are not one island.

interestCards.title: Xứ dừa
interestCards.summary: Coconut palms, a candy kiln, and shell craft. The area figures do not match, so all three are kept.

interestCards.title: Hồ Trúc Giang
interestCards.summary: The lake and the parks after dinner, then the night market and khu phố chợ Phú Khương.

interestCards.title: Đồng Khởi
interestCards.summary: The 17 January 1960 ground at Định Thủy, a second morning, not the town park of the same name.

interestGroups.title: The Tiền and the islets
interestGroups.summary: For a boat on this bank of the river, not a canal morning in Cần Thơ.
body: Cồn Phụng is the longer version of the river day. On the ground of Đạo Dừa you walk Tòa Bảo tháp, Sân Rồng with nine dragons for the nine Mekong mouths, and Cửu Trùng đài. The rural page adds coconut candy, rice paper, more than 500 shell-craft objects, honey tea, đờn ca tài tử, a horse cart under the palms, and a sampan in a nipa creek. A stage time for the music was not printed. Check on arrival. The town boat is the shorter version: a nipa creek, a kiln, fruit in season, a sampan, and lunch under the palms, from bến tàu du lịch thành phố Bến Tre. That pier is not the Cồn Phụng wharf.

Cồn Quy is longan, honey tea, and a ditch you can bail for fish and cook. No commune and no kilometer were printed. Do not reuse the Cồn Phụng distances. A month for the longan blossom is check on arrival. Cù lao Long is a morning bicycle past the Ben Tre Market and the Ben Tre River, then a short ferry. The ferry fare, the minute, and the dock’s street number are check on arrival. Other islets on the Hàm Luông stay unnamed. The water park is not this day.

cards.title: Cồn Phụng and the river
cards.summary: 12 km by road and 25 km by river, or about 10 km. The gate is check on arrival. Lân has no bank assigned.

interestGroups.title: Xứ dừa
interestGroups.summary: For the palms, the kiln, and the two craft villages inland.
body: The rural page calls this the coconut country of Vietnam and prints more than 60,000 ha and about 500 million nuts a year. The national extract prints 53,000 ha, about a quarter of the country’s coconut land, and about 500 million nuts. Báo Đồng Khởi says the area was above 62,000 ha by the 2015 festival. Candy, milk, oil, and shell craft are the products. The plain candy is coconut milk and sugar. Eat it warm at the kiln.

Mỹ Lồng, old xã Mỹ Thạnh, huyện Giồng Trôm, is the rice-paper yard. Clause 92 merges Mỹ Thạnh, Thuận Điền, and Lương Phú into xã Lương Phú and does not erase the craft name. Sơn Đốc sits in xã Hưng Nhượng, with the work in the hamlets and ấp Hưng Bình named for the households. Clause 88 keeps the name Hưng Nhượng. The two yards are not the same visit. A kilometer from town to either village is check on arrival.

cards.title: Coconut country
cards.summary: 53,000 ha, more than 60,000 ha, and above 62,000 ha. About 500 million nuts on the two tourism pages.

interestGroups.title: Hồ Trúc Giang after dark
interestGroups.summary: For the night you stay: the lake, the parks, and the market street.
body: After dinner the portal walks Hồ Trúc Giang, công viên Bến Tre, công viên Trần Văn Ơn, and công viên Đồng Khởi, then chợ đêm Bến Tre and khu phố chợ Phú Khương. The night is that walk. A bar row was not named. The hour the lake goes quiet is check on arrival. An opening hour for the market was not printed. Check on arrival.

On Fridays and Saturdays a free seven-seat cart picks up at Sense City, 26A Trần Quốc Tuấn, at 17:30 and 19:30, and at 708 Nguyễn Văn Tư at 19:00 and 21:00. Sense City is the mall on that page. Coconut-shell craft, more than 500 objects on the rural page, is the souvenir, at the islet workshops. Clause 117 merges the old phường Phú Khương into a new phường Phú Khương with Phường 8, Phú Hưng, and Nhơn Thạnh. The portal still calls the night street khu phố chợ Phú Khương.

cards.title: The lake and the market street
cards.summary: Hồ Trúc Giang, three parks, then chợ đêm Bến Tre and khu phố chợ Phú Khương. The quiet hour is check on arrival.

interestGroups.title: Đồng Khởi
interestGroups.summary: For the 17 January 1960 ground, on a morning that is not the boat.
body: The rising opened on the morning of 17 January 1960 at Đình Rắn and the Vàm Nước post, in old xã Định Thủy, huyện Mỏ Cày Nam. The heritage page says Mỏ Cày Nam. The national extract says the same old district. Clause 70 merges Định Thủy, Phước Hiệp, and Bình Khánh into xã Đồng Khởi and does not say the house moved. Nhà truyền thống opened on 17 January 2000, nearly 5,000 m², on the old province-chief compound. The torch is 12 m high and 4.5 m across, with three wings. Đình Rắn, also called đình Định Nhơn, is 500 m northeast, rebuilt in 2005, 11 m by 25 m. The eight gold characters on the stone, from Hồ Chí Minh, read “Anh dũng Đồng Khởi, thắng Mỹ diệt ngụy”.

No ticket and no visit length were on the heritage page. Check on arrival. The anniversary gatherings use 17 January. A 2026 or 2027 stage list was not opened. Check on arrival for a gathered schedule beyond the date. Do not look for this house in công viên Đồng Khởi in town.

cards.title: The Định Thủy relic
cards.summary: Across Cầu Hàm Luông, more than 10 km then about 4 km, or about 15 km. The fee is check on arrival.

interestGroups.title: Nguyễn Đình Chiểu
interestGroups.summary: For the poet’s tomb at Ba Tri, on 1 July or on an ordinary day.
body: The tomb and memorial sit at old xã An Đức, 2 km from the center of thị trấn Ba Tri, on tỉnh lộ 885 through Giồng Trôm. Clause 83 merges thị trấn Ba Tri and the communes Vĩnh Hòa, An Đức, Vĩnh An, and An Bình Tây into xã Ba Tri and does not say the tomb moved. The culture department’s site says the Ministry of Culture and Information listed it a national historic relic on 27 April 1990, on 13,000 m². The birth date on that site is 1 July 1822. He was not born in Bến Tre. He lived and worked here.

The culture program runs 30 June–2 July, and the day itself is 1 July on the solar calendar. On an ordinary day the ground is still the visit. Hours and a ticket were not printed. Check on arrival. Drive minutes from the town are check on arrival. The program includes đờn ca tài tử, a costume play of Lục Vân Tiên and Kiều Nguyệt Nga, recited verse, drum, traditional martial arts, a feast, and yard games.

cards.title: The Ba Tri memorial
cards.summary: A national historic relic since 27 April 1990. The culture day is 1 July. Hours are check on arrival.

interestGroups.title: Chợ Lách gardens
interestGroups.summary: For fruit and ornamental gardens inland, with no single gate named.
body: The rural page groups daily visits in Châu Thành, Chợ Lách, and Ba Tri, and names fruit and ornamental gardens without a village street. The investment sheet says the same, in pre-merger language. Clause 64 merges Long Thới, Hòa Nghĩa, and thị trấn Chợ Lách into xã Chợ Lách. A village called Cái Mơn was not named.
You walk the gardens. The page does not name a gate. A kilometer, a fee, and a month were not printed. The rural page says fruit year-round. Check on arrival.

cards.title: Fruit and nursery rows
cards.summary: Gardens in Chợ Lách, Châu Thành, and Ba Tri. No single gate, and no month was named.

interestGroups.title: The sea edge
interestGroups.summary: For a wild shore at Bình Đại, Ba Tri, and Thạnh Phú, not a resort coast.
body: The rural page says beach projects were hoped for and that no investor had built a resort zone yet. Visitors still come for the wild shore and the seafood. Seafood is the plate, not a named restaurant. The culture page adds nearly 20 km of beach at Ba Tri. The national extract prints 65 km for the whole old province. Those are not the same measurement.

Ba Tri is the poet road, tỉnh lộ 885. Minutes to the sand are check on arrival. A fee was not printed. Check on arrival. A month for the beach was not printed. The 2024–2025 salinity note is a forecast for the rivers, not a beach calendar.

cards.title: Bình Đại, Ba Tri, Thạnh Phú
cards.summary: Nearly 20 km of beach at Ba Tri, and 65 km for the old province. A resort investor was not there.

interestGroups.title: A family on the water
interestGroups.summary: For the boat, the sampan, and the kiln, with the water park only after that.
body: The family day is the boat, the sampan in a nipa creek, and the candy kiln. After dark the portal describes a motorboat along bần and nipa, with young coconut and fruit on board and fireflies in the creeks. A departure clock was not printed. Check on arrival. Đờn ca tài tử at the garden stop has no separate ticket in the sources. Check on arrival.

TTC Mekong Aqua Park, at 547D Nguyễn Đình Chiểu, ấp Phú Chiến, xã Phú Hưng, is the extra the portal offers, with Tiny Zoo and a lunch court beside it. Clause 117 does not name Nguyễn Đình Chiểu. The address stays. One page. No tariff was opened. Hours and a kilometer are check on arrival. It is a hot afternoon after the boat, not the reason to come.

cards.title: Boat, sampan, kiln
cards.summary: The family day on the water. The water park is the afternoon extra. Its fee is check on arrival.

faqs.q: How far is Ben Tre from Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: The investment sheet prints 86 km and 1.5 hours by car on the Ho Chi Minh City–Trung Lương expressway. Vietnam Tourism prints about two hours. A travel page prints about 85 km and about 2 hours. A car-hire page prints 85–90 km and 1.5–2 hours. Fares are check on arrival. No passenger train was named. Minutes from Tân Sơn Nhất are check on arrival.

faqs.q: How far is Cồn Phụng, and what is the gate?
faqs.a: The national rural page prints 12 km by road and 25 km by river from the city center. The operator page prints about 10 km. The rural page prints no tariff, so the gate is check on arrival. The town orchard pier is a different landing.

faqs.q: Which province is this, and how big is it?
faqs.a: Clause 20 of Nghị quyết 202/2025/QH15, as printed by VOV, joins Bến Tre, Trà Vinh, and Vĩnh Long into the new Vĩnh Long province, 6,296.20 km² and 4,257,581 people, beside Đồng Tháp, Cần Thơ, and the sea. The investment sheet still prints the old province at 2,379.7 km² and 1,299,328 people, with Tiền Giang to the north, Trà Vinh to the south, Vĩnh Long to the west, and the sea to the east. That sheet is the pre-merger province. Article 2 tells the Government to fix the boundary. The clause does not name a capital.

The national extract says the coconut festival is held every two years around 30 April. Báo Đồng Khởi, 27 March 2019, lists 2009, 2010, 2012, 2015, and a fifth edition then planned for November 2019. Those lists do not match. The next date is check on arrival. The culture day at the poet’s memorial is 1 July, with a program from 30 June to 2 July. Đồng Khởi gatherings use 17 January. Nghinh Ông is the 15th and 16th of the sixth lunar month, and the fruit fair is Tết Đoan Ngọ on the 5th of the fifth lunar month. The solar days move. Check on arrival.

season.label: Mild year-round
season.note: The national rural page says the weather is mild year-round and does not print a rainy month. VOV, 16 November 2024, reports a provincial directive for the dry season 2024–2025: salinity could reach the rivers from the second half of December 2024 and peak about February and March 2025. That is one season’s forecast. A month when the 2026 boat stops is check on arrival. VOV, 6 October 2024, reports rain flooding nearly 0.5 m deep on Quốc lộ 57B near Khu công nghiệp Giao Long. That is not a closure of the Rạch Miễu crossing. A 2026 closure of Quốc lộ 60 is check on arrival. The coconut festival is every two years around 30 April on the national extract, and 2009, 2010, 2012, 2015, plus a fifth edition then planned for November 2019, on Báo Đồng Khởi. The next edition is check on arrival. The culture day is 1 July. Đồng Khởi uses 17 January.
